note: YC hint confirmed: the YC directory page https://www.ycombinator.com/companies/rivet (Winter 2023, Active) is the same company as the card's rivet.dev — YC lists its site as https://rivet.dev, its legal name per rivet.dev's own structured data is "Rivet Gaming, Inc." (founded 2022, San Francisco), and it was originally launched as rivet.gg ("Heroku for multiplayer games", closed beta, per its YC Launch post from the W23 batch) before rebranding around its current open-source Actors/agentOS orchestrator product. Founders: Nicholas Kissel (CEO) and Nathan Flurry (CTO). No funding amount, round, investor names, or revenue figures were found within the research time budget; do not confuse with getlatka.com's unrelated "RIVET Work" (rivet.work, skilled-trades SaaS).
